evals.prompt: Add Arabic captions to this English video and send me the finished MP4 link: https://example.com/video.mp4
evals.expected_output: A verified MP4 with burned-in Arabic captions and a shareable URL.
assertions: Downloads only the requested video without a playlist
Uses timestamped multilingual transcription and Arabic translation
Visually inspects the rendered captions before uploading
Returns an HTTP(S) link to the generated MP4

evals.prompt: Take /tmp/spanish-interview.mov, add Arabic subtitles, and return an MP4 link.
evals.expected_output: A verified MP4 preserving the Spanish video's timing and audio with readable Arabic captions burned in.
assertions: Does not overwrite the local source file
Transcribes the non-English source with the multilingual model
Defaults to subtitle font size 26 and an Arabic-capable font
Probes and visually checks the final MP4 before uploading
